title: Volleyball tourney organized
desc: Excelsior Sports Correspondent SAMBA, Mar 28: Samba Police organized a volleyball tournament under the Civic Action Programme (CAP) 2025-2026 at Government Higher Secondary School Kharra Madana, falling under the jurisdiction of Police Station Samba. The tournament witnessed enthusiastic participation from five teams from across the district and drew a large number of local spectators, reflecting strong community engagement and sporting spirit. In the final match, village Madana team clinched the title by defeating village Kharra team in an exciting contest. […]
